newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico '96 construction to grow 6 pct-GFB.
newsitem.headline: Mexico '96 construction to grow 6 pct-GFB.

text.p: The Mexican construction industry may grow by six percent in 1996, Grupo Financiero Bancomer (GFB) said in a news release on Monday.
"Production volume by the construction industry in July was steady for the third month in a row...so the industry may reach year-on-year growth of almost six percent in 1996," GFB said.
GFB noted that GDP for the construction industry was up 7.8 percent in July compared to the same month in 1995.
A recovery in output in Mexico, lower nominal interest rates, an increase in employment and more wage earners were all seen as boosting demand for construction work, GFB added.
